rules.name: Project Overview
rules.description: This is a full-stack Ethereum dApp implementing an Aave V3 flash loan arbitrage strategy between Uniswap V2 and SushiSwap V2 on the Sepolia testnet. The backend uses Solidity/Truffle, and the frontend uses Next.js/React/TypeScript.

rules.name: Smart Contract Core Logic
rules.description: The main smart contract `FlashLoan.sol` inherits from Aave's `FlashLoanSimpleReceiverBase` and implements the `executeOperation` callback to perform the USDC -> WETH (Uniswap) -> USDC (SushiSwap) arbitrage. It requires the Aave Pool Addresses Provider address during deployment.

rules.name: Backend Frameworks & Libraries
rules.description: The backend uses Truffle for compilation, migration, and testing. It relies on Ganache for local development (including Sepolia forks) and utilizes OpenZeppelin contracts and Aave V3 core contracts.

rules.name: Frontend Frameworks & Libraries
rules.description: The frontend is built with Next.js (App Router, Turbopack), React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It uses `web3.js` and `ethers.js` for blockchain interaction.

rules.name: Frontend Web3 Integration
rules.description: The `Web3Provider` component (`frontend/components/web3/Web3Provider.tsx`) uses React Context to manage wallet connection (MetaMask), account details, and network status (checking for Sepolia). Core Web3 utilities are in `frontend/lib/web3/`. Contracts are loaded via `frontend/lib/web3/contracts.ts` using JSON artifacts.

rules.name: Contract Artifact Handling
rules.description: The `copy-contracts.js` script (run via `npm run copy-contracts` or `postmigrate`) copies compiled contract JSON artifacts from `build/contracts` to `frontend/contracts` to make ABIs and deployment addresses available to the frontend.

rules.name: Testing Strategy
rules.description: Smart contract tests (`test/flashLoan.test.js`) use Truffle and OpenZeppelin test helpers. Testing the core flash loan logic relies heavily on running against a Sepolia fork (`development_fork` network in Truffle config) to interact with live testnet contracts.

rules.name: Target Network: Sepolia
rules.description: The primary target network for deployment and testing (besides local development) is the Sepolia testnet. Configuration files and contracts contain Sepolia-specific addresses and IDs.

rules.name: Key Concept: Flash Loan
rules.description: Central concept involving borrowing assets (USDC) from Aave V3 without collateral, executing logic (arbitrage), and repaying the loan plus a fee within the same transaction.

rules.name: Key Concept: Arbitrage
rules.description: The strategy aims to exploit price differences for the same asset pair (USDC/WETH) between two DEXs (Uniswap V2 and SushiSwap V2 on Sepolia).
